<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-1816-47-55" status="unreviewed">yang <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> na re gzung don la ma 'khrul bas mngon suM gyi rigs mi mthun mtha' dag se l ba yin te | dgag bya mngon suM ltar snang 2 ka gzung don la 'khrul ba yin pa'i phyir rtog bral ni log rtogs sel ba'i mtshid yino zhes ser
               <lb n="34b3"/>'di mi rigs te de ltar na 'phags pa rnams kyi dang rtha mi rtog pa'i ye+es 'di chos kyi dbyings la ltos te mngon suM ma yin par 'gyur gzung don la ma 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir dgag gzhi dngos po dngos su rtogs pas ma grub po zhe na | mnyam gzhag ldog de la dngos po snang bar 'gyur 'dod na snang med kyi yes ma yin par thal 'dod par mi nus te
               <lb n="34b4"/>ji skad du snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa || des ni theg pa chen por mthong ces pa dang | 'ga' yang mthong ba med pa ni de kho na nyid mngon suM du mthong ba'o zhes gsungs so | des na rtog bral gyis rtog pa mngon suM ltar se l ma 'khrul bas 'khrul pa mngon suM ltar snang bsal bas mtshon bya mngon gyi tha snyad du mtshon pa yino |</seg></TEI>
